wikipediaSummary.title: Freak Out!
wikipediaSummary.description: 1966 studio album by the Mothers of Invention
wikipediaSummary.extract: Freak Out! is the debut studio album by the American rock band the Mothers of Invention, released on June 27, 1966, by Verve Records. Often cited as one of rock music's first concept albums, it is a satirical expression of guitarist/bandleader Frank Zappa's perception of American pop culture and the nascent Los Angeles freak scene's "freak-out" trend.
